submitted.rationale: Bi0.92Sb0.08 gave the highest measured EQE (1.40e-4 %). XRD shows it is mostly a Bi2O3/Bi4O7-like Bi-rich phase plus a fluorite-type phase. The Bi-rich end did better than the 1:1 composition, and the most Bi-rich point, index 0 (Bi0.97), fell back to 1.04e-4 %. That puts the maximum near 8% Sb.

rejected.reason: Bi0.49Sb0.51: measured EQE 8.7e-6 %, about 16x lower. Its XRD is dominated by a phase that no database structure matches well.
Bi0.97Sb0.03: measured EQE 1.04e-4 %, lower than index 5.
